args.body:
Dear Priya,

Thank you for bringing this urgent API timeout issue to our attention. I understand this is blocking your users, and I want to assure you we're taking this seriously.

We've started investigating the API timeout problem immediately and will provide you with updates as soon as we have more information. Could you please share any additional details that might help us investigate, such as:

1. Specific API endpoints affected
2. Timeframes when the timeouts occur
3. Any error messages or codes you're seeing
4. The impact on your user operations

We'll prioritize resolving this issue and will keep you informed of our progress.

Best regards,
Support Team
